title: Consulting invoice JSON
prompt:
Create an invoice as one JSON object and nothing else for Northwind Studio, invoice INV-204, billed in USD. Two line items: design review for 400 and copy edit for 150. The total is 550.

The object must include the keys invoiceId, currency, total, and lineItems. currency must be a three-letter uppercase code. Do not include an SSN, a CVV, a card number, or a 13 to 19 digit number.
constraints: Keys invoiceId, currency, total, and lineItems
currency is a three-letter uppercase code
